author: rdc-rfc1-author-a (Claude Haiku 5.5)
rationale: Both configuration registers are reset by por_n, which has an input delay on clk, and cfg_shadow samples cfg in the same reset domain. sw_rst_n is unused, which is a lint matter with no reset-domain effect.

author_reading.rationale: sw_rst_n is a declared reset input that reaches no flop, so a software reset never restores cfg to its default.

labels.rationale: Both registers are reset by por_n on the same clock and cfg_shadow samples cfg, so there is no reset-domain defect. sw_rst_n is declared but unused, which is a lint matter. por_n and sw_rst_n carry set_input_delay.

Both configuration registers share the same reset and reset value. The SDC supplies a reset input-delay contract referenced to their clock, and the shadow captures the previous configuration on an ordinary edge.

settlement.rationale: Both readers judge good and the settler agrees. The author's defect (an unused software-reset input) is not a reset-domain defect. The readers differ only on the class; the case is the inventory lookalike of rfc1-a04.
